Any Orc or Goblin within 4" of the Shaman will automatically strike first in hand-to-hand combat regardless of other circumstances.
The spell only lasts until the caster is knocked down, stunned or taken out of action.

Range 8". Moves any enemy model within range D6" directly away from the Shaman.
If the target collides with another model or a building, both suffer 1 S3 hit.
Note: Very handy for dropping people from high buildings with.
May not be cast on models in hand-to-hand combat.
Range 12". Causes D3 S4 hits on the closest enemy target, with no armour saves allowed.

No enemy may charge the Shaman during their next turn.
If the Shaman is engaged in hand-to-hand combat he may immediately move 4" away.

The ectoplasmic club counts as a normal club with +2 Strength bonus and gives the Shaman +1 attack as well.
This spell lasts until the Shaman suffers a wound.

Range 12". Each of the two bolts causes D3 S3 hits; the bolts can either be fired both at the closest enemy target
or split between the two closest enemy targets.

modifiers.value: To promote a henchmen to hero, duplicate the group. Set one group to 1 promoted model and decrease the size of the remaining henchmen group by 1.
